compiled_state.title: As a bridge operator, I can verify the GitHub Actions runner is available for reconcile-bridge.yml
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Verify that the GitHub Actions runner environment that will execute `reconcile-bridge.yml` is reachable and that `gh` CLI commands can query workflow run history.
**Why**: The reconciler runs as a scheduled GitHub Actions workflow. If the runner is unavailable or the workflow name is wrong, the entire level-triggered design fails at the scheduling layer.
**Scope**:
- IN: Verify `gh run list --workflow=reconcile-bridge.yml --limit 1` executes without error; verify runner quota/concurrency configuration
- OUT: Creating or scheduling the workflow itself (that is part of the cutover story)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, `gh run list --workflow=reconcile-bridge.yml --limit 1` executes without authentication error and returns a valid response (may be empty on a fresh repo)
  ← Validates Closure Check: "reconcile-bridge.yml runs on the configured ~20-min schedule"

## Closure Checks
- Verification command output logged as story comment

## Considerations
- [Reliability] GHA concurrency group `reconcile-bridge` must be configured in the workflow; verify no conflict with existing workflow names

## Escalation Policy
**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
